summary: Iter 87 — Children's Books in Sanctus Library. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASSED covering (a) GET /api/library/books returns exactly 3 children books with correct slugs, expected chapter counts (bible-stories-for-little-souls=12, little-saints-for-little-hearts=9, the-holy-mass-for-little-ones=8), and is_premium=false, (b) each children book detail returns full chapter list, (c) chapter 0 body_md returns full text (>500 chars, includes 'In the very beginning'), no is_locked/paywall flags, (d) regression: spiritual classics (some premium) and papal encyclicals (free) still present. Frontend: Verified in mobile viewport (390x844) with valid session token. 'For Children' section (testID library-section-children) renders with 'For Children' heading, all 3 book cards present (testID library-book-card-<slug>), each with 'Free to read' tag (testID library-free-tag-<slug>). Tapping a children book card navigates to /library/books/<slug>, chapter list renders (12 chapters with word counts), opening chapter 1 shows the full story text ('In the very beginning, there was only God...') with NO lock/paywall UI. Regression: 'Free to read' filter chip works and keeps children books visible; 'Books' (Summa, Confessions, etc. with premium lock badges) and 'Encyclicals' sections still render.
critical_code_review_comments: library_children_data.py is well-structured with clean, original text (public-domain retellings) — no copyright risk. All 3 books use tradition='children' consistently.

Frontend library/index.tsx correctly separates children/encyclicals/authored via memoized grouping; testIDs added for section header, card, and free tag. The 'Free to read' filter uses is_premium boolean and correctly includes children books (they are all is_premium=false).
seed_data_creation: None — children books are seeded automatically on backend startup via _seed_books_if_missing() from CHILDREN_BOOKS list.
